item.title: Pope Leo tells Villanova and Notre Dame basketball teams he is neutral. Prevost has other ideas
item.dc:creator: Associated Press
item.description: Pope Leo XIV welcomed Villanova and Notre Dame players at the Vatican ahead of their season opener in Rome.

item.title: New York court takes up Trump’s latest efforts to toss hush money conviction
item.dc:creator: Erik Uebelacker
item.description: Trump claims the case was “the most politically charged prosecution in our nation’s history.”

item.title: Congo’s Ebola deaths top 5,000 as fear of continent-wide spread mounts
item.dc:creator: Associated Press
item.description: Congo’s Ebola outbreak has claimed more than 5,000 lives as cases emerge elsewhere in Africa.

item.title: Other women contacted police about previous incidents with Packers’ Josh Jacobs after his arrest
item.dc:creator: Associated Press
item.description: Multiple women reported separate allegations involving Josh Jacobs while police investigated an altercation with his former girlfriend.

item.title: G20 foreign ministers in Atlanta meeting head to an ending without consensus on key issues
item.dc:creator: Associated Press
item.description: G20 diplomats are concluding talks in Atlanta amid persistent divisions over Ukraine and other global security challenges.

item.title: ‘Act III’ of mass protests can’t run through central Paris on Halloween, France’s top court rules
item.dc:creator: Lily Radziemski
item.description: Demonstrations are underway on the outskirts of Paris as authorities cite a “high risk to public order” intensified by Halloween. But pushing the movement outside of the city has sparked widespread debate over fundamental rights.

item.title: Judge lets Bay Area woman keep her ‘RVRTSEA’ license plate — for now
item.dc:creator: Hillel Aron
item.description: Three people complained to the California DMV about the license plate's political message.

item.title: Prosecution’s star witness describes bribery plot in trial of ex-Oakland mayor
item.dc:creator: Margaret Attridge
item.description: Mario Juarez, a former associate of businessmen David and Andrew Duong, testified he worked closely with the father and son duo to bribe former Oakland Mayor Sheng Thao and her partner Andre Jones for lucrative city contracts.

item.title: Idaho gets green light to enforce abortion ban in health-risk cases
item.dc:creator: Jeremy Yurow
item.description: A divided Ninth Circuit panel said the Supreme Court’s Dobbs decision likely defeats a doctor’s challenge.

item.title: European Union and Canada to form new alliance — but no associate membership yet
item.dc:creator: Tatiana Mulowayi-Pelletier
item.description: The 21st EU-Canada Summit closed on Friday with a joint statement addressing the future of Canada's relationship to the European Union.
